final: SELECT cs.raceId, AVG(cs.points) AS average_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins, AVG(cs.wins) - (SELECT AVG(race_average_wins) FROM (SELECT AVG(wins) AS race_average_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points >= 6.0 GROUP BY raceId)) AS difference FROM constructorStandings AS cs WHERE cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY cs.raceId ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
